## Day 71 Solution: Real Tools Review

Re-runs each Week 10 workflow via Execute Workflow, then a Sticky Note below holds the model Week 10 summary and portfolio notes you'd otherwise write by hand.

**Credentials needed:** None new.

See `DAILY_TASKS/DAY_71_Real_Tools_Review.md`.

## Week 10 Summary

**Advanced integration chain (Day 65):** built a true 3-deep dependency chain across weather, exchange-rate, and quote APIs with a computed health score branching to Slack.

**Custom API integrations (Day 66):** two real third-party APIs (weather, news) with clean field extraction and status-code error routing.

**Data sync (Day 67):** bidirectional Airtable/Notion sync with a last-updated-wins conflict rule and a Sync Log.

**Orchestration (Day 68):** 5 independent worker workflows called sequentially, in parallel, and conditionally from one orchestrator.

**Error handling (Day 69):** retry + fallback + Error Log + Slack alert only on fallback/total failure.

**Performance (Day 70):** timestamp-based caching and Split In Batches, with a real before/after execution-time comparison.

**Portfolio-ready pick:** Day 68's orchestrator — clearest node names, most reusable pattern.
**Not yet portfolio-ready:** Day 66 — needs cleaner error messaging and a written setup guide before showing a client.
**3 real services now hands-on:** open-meteo.com, exchangerate.host, NewsAPI.org.
